items.title: Steve Buckingham, interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, February 25, 2019 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: Billy Preston playing organ for God’s sakes. I mean, but I saw all those guys play.

ctx.x: No. And besides the New York horn section they brought in the Memphis horns. Two white guys and a black guy from Memphis to play. It was an unbelievable band. They opened the show and then Aretha comes on. And that’s the same thing when you see Aretha live, the record “Aretha Live at the Filmore West” when Ray Charles came. That was that band. Yeah. Billy Preston playing organ for God’s sakes. I mean, but I saw all those guys play. And Tom Scott did one in New York called the New York Connection with Pretty…
